title: [Infdev+] Gentler Foliage
description: A texture pack for Infdev+ that makes grass, oak leaves, and apple tree leaves a lot less headache-inducing.
body:
We all know about early Minecraft's neon green grass. This grass was carried over into Infdev+, which is understandable. Some people love it, some people hate it. For those of you who hate it, this pack is for you!

The pack is super simple, it just slightly recolors a lot of the neon green blocks into being a nicer, darker shade of green. No more headaches!

The following are changed:

Grass (sides and top)
Tall Grass
Ancient Oak, Oak, and Apple sapling leaves
Oak Leaves (transparent and opaque)
Ancient Oak leaves (transparent and opaque)
Apple Tree Leaves (transparent and opaque)
